<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Sora:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<title>MAXOWN — Bhat Zubair | MOD & Loader Developer</title>
<style>
:root{box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);color-scheme:dark;
--bg:#08080a;--card:#111114;--card2:#16161a;--line:#232328;--tx:#fafafa;--mut:#9a9aa5;--ac:#ff3d6e;--ac2:#ff6a4d;--grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff3d6e,#ff6a4d)}
html{scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 76px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans",Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;line-height:1.55;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:60;background:var(--bg)}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
h1,h2,h3,.logo,.btn,.tag,.steps .card::before{font-family:Sora,"Plus Jakarta Sans",Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}
svg{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}
i[data-i]{display:inline-flex}
.w{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:50;padding:12px 0}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:8px 8px 8px 22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(17,17,20,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
.logo{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:19px}.logo b{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.links{display:flex;gap:28px;color:var(--mut);font-size:14.5px}.links a:hover{color:var(--tx)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);transition:.25s;cursor:pointer;color:var(--tx)}
.btn:hover{background:var(--card2);border-color:#34343b}
.btn.p{background:var(--grad);border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 10px 30px -8px rgba(255,61,110,.55)}
.btn.p:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 36px -8px rgba(255,61,110,.7)}
.sm{padding:11px 20px;font-size:14px}
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:var(--card);font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.badge i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,61,110,.18)}
.hero{padding:56px 0 20px;text-align:center;position:relative}
.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:-60px;width:760px;max-width:140%;height:520px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,61,110,.2),transparent);z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}
h1{font-size:clamp(33px,7.2vw,70px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:24px auto 20px;max-width:900px;font-weight:800}
.g{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.lead{color:var(--mut);max-width:600px;margin:0 auto 30px;font-size:clamp(16px,2.2vw,18.5px)}
.cta{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.soc{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.soc a{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);transition:.25s;font-size:20px}
.soc a:hover{background:var(--grad);border-color:transparent;transform:translateY(-3px)}
.hero .soc{margin-top:26px}
.stage{position:relative;height:clamp(330px,64vw,470px);margin-top:36px;perspective:1100px;cursor:grab;touch-action:pan-y;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;overflow:visible}
.stage:active{cursor:grabbing}
.ring{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:0;height:0;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.pn{position:absolute;border-radius:22px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);background-size:cover;background-color:var(--card);backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.8);overflow:hidden}
.pn::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 60%,rgba(8,8,10,.55))}
.i1{background-image:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,)}.i2{background-image:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,)}
.hint{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.mq{overflow:hidden;border-block:1px solid var(--line);padding:20px 0;margin:56px 0 0;white-space:nowrap;mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 12%,#000 88%,transparent);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 12%,#000 88%,transparent)}
.mq div{display:inline-flex;animation:mq 30s linear infinite;font-size:20px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
.mq span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center}.mq span::after{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac);margin:0 36px}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
section{padding:84px 0 0}
.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:var(--card);color:var(--ac);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
h2{font-size:clamp(27px,4.8vw,44px);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:18px 0 14px;font-weight:800}
.sub{color:var(--mut);max-width:560px;margin:0 0 40px}
.hd{text-align:center}.hd .sub{margin-inline:auto}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:16px}
.card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--card2),var(--card));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;padding:28px;transition:.3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.card:hover{border-color:rgba(255,61,110,.5);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.card::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-60px;width:160px;height:160px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,61,110,.14),transparent);opacity:0;transition:.3s}
.card:hover::after{opacity:1}
.ic{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:15px;background:rgba(255,61,110,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,61,110,.25);color:var(--ac);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px;margin-bottom:20px}
.card h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.01em}.card p{margin:0;color:var(--mut);font-size:15px}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.tilt{perspective:900px;touch-action:pan-y}
.tc{aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:30px;border:1px solid var(--line);background-size:cover;background-position:50% 30%;transition:transform .15s ease-out;transform-style:preserve-3d;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -30px rgba(255,61,110,.35)}
.about p{color:var(--mut);margin:0 0 14px}.about strong{color:var(--tx)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:22px}.chips span{padding:9px 17px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:var(--card);font-size:14px}
.loc{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;margin-top:20px}.loc svg{color:var(--ac)}
.steps{counter-reset:s}.steps .card{padding-top:70px}
.steps .card::before{counter-increment:s;content:"0" counter(s);position:absolute;top:24px;left:28px;font-size:34px;font-weight:800;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.faq{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto}
details{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:var(--card);padding:20px 24px;margin-bottom:12px;transition:.2s}
details[open]{border-color:rgba(255,61,110,.4)}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
summary::after{content:"+";color:var(--ac);font-size:24px;line-height:1}details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
details p{color:var(--mut);margin:12px 0 0}
.big{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:34px;padding:clamp(40px,7vw,84px) 24px;text-align:center}
.big::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-220px;width:700px;max-width:130%;height:420px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,61,110,.35),transparent)}
.big>*{position:relative}.big h2{max-width:720px;margin-inline:auto}.big .sub{margin-inline:auto}
.note{margin-top:18px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
footer{padding:34px 0 30px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:84px}
.ft{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.ft .soc a{width:40px;height:40px;font-size:17px}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .7s,transform .7s}.rv.on{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(max-width:760px){.links{display:none}.about{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}section{padding-top:64px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.mq div{animation:none}.rv{opacity:1;transform:none}html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style>
<style>
/* Liquid glass layer */
.orbs{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.orbs i{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.5;animation:fl 20s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.orbs i:nth-child(1){width:520px;height:520px;background:#ff3d6e;top:-160px;left:-160px}
.orbs i:nth-child(2){width:460px;height:460px;background:#6d4aff;top:38%;right:-180px;opacity:.42;animation-delay:-6s}
.orbs i:nth-child(3){width:480px;height:480px;background:#ff7a45;bottom:-200px;left:18%;opacity:.3;animation-delay:-12s}
@keyframes fl{to{transform:translate3d(70px,50px,0) scale(1.18)}}
.nav,.card,.badge,.tag,.chips span,details,.big,.soc a,.btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.11),rgba(255,255,255,.03));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(175%);backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(175%);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3),inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04),0 14px 40px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.65)}
@supports not ((backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(1px))){.nav,.card,.badge,.tag,.chips span,details,.big,.soc a,.btn{background:rgba(30,30,38,.9)}}
.nav{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.13),rgba(255,255,255,.04))}
.btn:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.18),rgba(255,255,255,.06));border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
.btn.p{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,61,110,.96),rgba(255,106,77,.92));border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55),inset 0 -8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.12),0 14px 36px -8px rgba(255,61,110,.6)}
.card{border-radius:28px}
.card::after{inset:0;right:auto;top:auto;width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(280px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,0%),rgba(255,255,255,.17),transparent 62%);opacity:0}
.card:hover::after{opacity:1}
.ic{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,61,110,.28),rgba(255,106,77,.1));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.big{border-radius:36px}
.pn{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5),inset 0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.07),0 30px 70px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.85)}
.pn::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(255,255,255,.3),transparent 38%);opacity:.7}
.tc{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5),inset 0 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.07),0 40px 80px -30px rgba(255,61,110,.5)}
.mq{background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.04),transparent)}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.orbs i{animation:none}}
</style>
<style>
/* Advanced interactions */
body.fine,.fine a,.fine button,.fine summary,.fine .stage,.fine .btn{cursor:none}
#pg{position:fixed;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);left:0;height:3px;width:0;background:var(--grad);z-index:70}
#spot{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:640px;height:640px;margin:-320px 0 0 -320px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,61,110,.14),transparent);z-index:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s}
#cur{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:38px;height:38px;margin:-19px 0 0 -19px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.75);border-radius:50%;z-index:300;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:background .25s,border-color .25s,opacity .3s;will-change:transform}
#cur.hov{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
#cur.lab{background:rgba(255,61,110,.92);border-color:transparent}
#dot{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:6px;height:6px;margin:-3px 0 0 -3px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;z-index:301;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
#clb{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:90px;height:16px;margin:-8px 0 0 -45px;text-align:center;font:700 10.5px/16px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#fff;z-index:302;pointer-events:none}
.rip{position:fixed;width:14px;height:14px;margin:-7px 0 0 -7px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--ac);pointer-events:none;z-index:300;animation:rip .7s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes rip{to{transform:scale(9);opacity:0}}
.pre{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:#08080a;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1);animation:pf .01s 3.4s forwards}
.pre.done{transform:translateY(-100%)}
@keyframes pf{to{visibility:hidden}}
.pl{text-align:center}.pl b{display:block;font:800 clamp(34px,9vw,72px)/1 Sora,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em}
.pre i{font-style:normal;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.pl span{display:block;margin-top:14px;font:600 13px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--mut)}.pl em{font-style:normal}
.pre u{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:3px;width:calc(var(--p,0)*100%);background:var(--grad)}
.logo{display:inline-block}
#cur{width:28px;height:33px;margin:-1px 0 0 -1px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:none;transform-origin:0 0;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 12px rgba(255,61,110,.6))}
#cur.hov,#cur.lab{background:none}
#cur svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#dot{display:none}
#clb{width:auto;height:auto;margin:16px 0 0 20px;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--grad);white-space:nowrap;font:700 10px/1 ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;letter-spacing:.12em}
#clb:empty{display:none}
.meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:30px}
.meta span{font:600 11.5px/1 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:11px 15px;color:var(--mut);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.meta b{color:var(--tx);font-weight:700}
.tag{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace}
.sp .wd{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding-bottom:.16em;margin-bottom:-.16em}
.sp .wd>span{display:inline-block;transform:translateY(112%);transition:transform .85s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.sp.in .wd>span{transform:none}
.stm{font:700 clamp(26px,5.4vw,56px)/1.2 Sora,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.03em;max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center}
.sw{color:rgba(255,255,255,.17);transition:color .35s}.sw.lit{color:var(--tx)}
.card.on{transition:opacity .7s,transform .22s ease-out,border-color .3s}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sp .wd>span{transform:none;transition:none}.pre{display:none}}
</style>
<style>
/* Multi-cursor engine */
#cur,#dot,#clb,#spot{display:none!important}
body.fine,.fine a,.fine button,.fine summary,.fine .btn{cursor:revert!important}
.fine .stage{cursor:grab!important}
#cursors{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:130;overflow:hidden}
#sel{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:0;overflow:visible;pointer-events:none;z-index:125}
.cur{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;will-change:transform}
.cur svg{display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.55));transition:transform .1s}
.cur.dn svg{transform:scale(.78)}
.cur.fl svg{animation:flt var(--d,3s) ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:var(--dl,0s)}
@keyframes flt{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) rotate(0)}25%{transform:translate(6px,-8px) rotate(5deg)}50%{transform:translate(-2px,-13px) rotate(-4deg)}75%{transform:translate(-7px,-5px) rotate(4deg)}}
.js .sx:not(.in){clip-path:inset(0 calc(100% - 1px) calc(100% - 1px) 0)}
.sel{position:absolute;outline:1.5px solid var(--c)}
.sel i{position:absolute;width:8px;height:8px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--c);margin:-4px 0 0 -4px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s}
.sel.done i{opacity:1}
.sel i:nth-child(1){left:0;top:0}.sel i:nth-child(2){left:50%;top:0}.sel i:nth-child(3){left:100%;top:0}.sel i:nth-child(4){left:0;top:50%}
.sel i:nth-child(5){left:100%;top:50%}.sel i:nth-child(6){left:0;top:100%}.sel i:nth-child(7){left:50%;top:100%}.sel i:nth-child(8){left:100%;top:100%}
.rip{position:absolute;width:10px;height:10px;margin:-5px 0 0 -5px;border:2px solid var(--c);border-radius:50%;animation:rip .6s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes rip{to{transform:scale(4);opacity:0}}
.caret{position:absolute;width:2px;background:var(--c);animation:bl .5s steps(2) infinite;z-index:126}@keyframes bl{50%{opacity:0}}
.js .ch{opacity:0}.js .ch.on{opacity:1}
.js [data-pop]:not(.in){opacity:0;transform:scale(.55)}
.js [data-pop].in{animation:popin .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
@keyframes popin{0%{transform:scale(.55)}60%{transform:scale(1.2)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.cur svg{width:22px;height:26px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="orbs" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
<div id="pg"></div><div id="cursors" aria-hidden="true"></div><div id="sel" aria-hidden="true"></div><div id="spot"></div><div id="cur"><svg viewBox="120 56 340 400" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M130 105Q130 62 172 66Q185 68 200 80L430 268Q452 286 445 308Q438 334 410 334L320 334Q292 336 268 366L212 434Q195 452 170 446Q145 438 142 408Z" fill="#fff" stroke="#08080a" stroke-width="14" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></div><div id="dot"></div><div id="clb"></div>
<div class="pre" id="pre"><div class="pl"><b>MAX<i>OWN</i></b><span><em id="pc">0</em>%</span></div><u></u></div>

<div class="w hero">
<span class="badge"><i></i>Available for bespoke projects</span>
<h1>MODs, loaders &amp; web apps built <span class="g">from scratch</span></h1>
<p class="lead">I’m Bhat Zubair, founder of TEAM MAX. A student and MOD/Loader developer from Baramulla, Kashmir, crafting fast, clean and powerful digital products.</p>
<div class="cta"><a class="btn p" href="#contact">Start a Project <i data-i="arr"></i></a><a class="btn" href="#services">See Services</a></div>
<div class="meta"><span>Based in <b>Baramulla, Kashmir</b></span><span>Open for <b>Paid projects</b></span><span>Focus <b>Mods · Loaders · Web</b></span></div>
<div class="stage" id="stage"><div class="ring" id="ring">
<div class="pn i1" style="background-position:50% 40%"></div>
<div class="pn i2" style="background-position:50% 30%"></div>
<div class="pn i1" style="background-position:30% 70%"></div>
<div class="pn i2" style="background-position:70% 55%"></div>
<div class="pn i1" style="background-position:60% 20%"></div>
<div class="pn i2" style="background-position:40% 75%"></div>
</div></div>
<span class="hint"><i data-i="drag"></i>Drag to rotate</span>
</div>

<div class="mq" aria-hidden="true"><div>
<span>MOD Development</span><span>Loaders</span><span>Web Apps</span><span>Shopify</span><span>WooCommerce</span><span>Custom APIs</span><span>Automation</span>

var w=r.width*p,h=r.height*p,l=center?r.left+(r.width-w)/2:r.left,t=center?r.top+(r.height-h)/2:r.top,a=(1-p)*100;
setBox(b,l,t,w,h);el.style.clipPath=center?'inset('+a/2+'% '+a/2+'% '+a/2+'% '+a/2+'%)':'inset(0 '+a+'% '+a+'% 0)';
c.x=l+w;c.y=t+h;c.tx=c.x;c.ty=c.y;if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);else res()})(t0)});
show(el);b.classList.add('done');await sleep(320);b.remove()}
async function typeEl(el,c){var chs=el._ch,r;
if(!chs.length){show(el);return}
await arrive(c,function(){r=chs[0].getBoundingClientRect();c.tx=r.left-3;c.ty=r.top+r.height*.6},45);
r=el.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.bottom<0||r.top>innerHeight){show(el);return}
var cr=D.createElement('div');cr.className='caret';cr.style.setProperty('--c',c.c);sel.appendChild(cr);
c.e.classList.add('dn');ripple(c);await sleep(90);c.e.classList.remove('dn');
var step=Math.max(16,Math.min(42,950/chs.length));
for(var i=0;i<chs.length;i++){chs[i].classList.add('on');r=chs[i].getBoundingClientRect();
cr.style.left=(r.right+scrollX)+'px';cr.style.top=(r.top+scrollY)+'px';cr.style.height=r.height+'px';c.tx=r.right+5;c.ty=r.bottom+8;await sleep(step)}
await sleep(260);cr.remove();el.classList.add('in')}
async function popEl(el,c){var r;
await arrive(c,function(){r=el.getBoundingClientRect();c.tx=r.left+r.width/2;c.ty=r.top+r.height/2},40);
r=el.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.bottom<0||r.top>innerHeight){show(el);return}
c.e.classList.add('dn');ripple(c);await sleep(120);el.classList.add('in');await sleep(380);c.e.classList.remove('dn')}
function ready(el){var p=el.parentElement&&el.parentElement.closest('.sx');return !p||p.classList.contains('in')}
var q=[],act=0,go=false;
function pump(){if(!go)return;q.sort(function(a,b){return a.getBoundingClientRect().top-b.getBoundingClientRect().top});
for(var i=0;i<q.length&&act<3;){var el=q[i];if(el.classList.contains('in')){q.splice(i,1);continue}
if(!ready(el)){i++;continue}q.splice(i,1);act++;run(el)}}
async function run(el){el._b=1;var c=await acquire();try{
if(el.hasAttribute('data-pop'))await popEl(el,c);else if(el._ch)await typeEl(el,c);else await reveal(el,c,el.id==='stage'||el.classList.contains('tilt'))}catch(e){show(el)}
free(c);act--;pump()}
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(x){if(!x.isIntersecting)return;var el=x.target;io.unobserve(el);q.push(el);
setTimeout(function(){if(!el.classList.contains('in')&&!el._b){q=q.filter(function(z){return z!==el});show(el)}},go?9000:11000);pump()})},{threshold:0,rootMargin:'0px 0px -5% 0px'});
tg.concat(tp,pp).filter(function(e){return !e.parentElement.closest('.sx')}).forEach(function(e){io.observe(e)});
setTimeout(function(){go=true;pump()},1500);
setInterval(function(){if(!go)return;D.querySelectorAll('.sx:not(.in),.tp:not(.in),[data-pop]:not(.in)').forEach(function(e){if(e._b)return;if(e.getBoundingClientRect().bottom<-40){q=q.filter(function(z){return z!==e});show(e)}})},900);
})();
</script>
